- Hit the documented `textbox`+`fromId` arrow bug (tail lands on a wrong fallback box) — avoided it by relying on proximity + highlight instead of a computed connector arrow for the far-apart callouts.
- Re-verified element IDs each time the live app's React re-mounted them (they changed across state changes).
- PII (the `huynq-vl` account chip) is redacted once via `globalEls`, confirmed clean on all three images.

Review filed for round 2.

**Verdict: changes-requested** (1 blocker remaining)

Checked each of the three round-1 findings specifically:

1. **Step-numbering duplication (nit)** — **not properly resolved.** Capture removed the redundant title text as asked, but the fix introduced a new, worse defect: both step-2 and step-3 callouts now render as an oversized (~90×100px) blank white card with only a tiny green "2"/"3" circle floating in the corner — the rest is empty white space. Root cause: `title` was set to `""` but `hideTitle` (a separate real prop, confirmed via `snap_kit`) was never set to `true`, so the title row still reserves its layout space even with no text in it. This looks like a rendering glitch, not a clean step marker, so I filed it as a **blocker** with the exact prop fix (`hideTitle: true`) and a fallback (explicit smaller `h`) if that's not enough.

2. **Missing Refresh Data highlight (nit)** — **fixed correctly.** Verified in `img/03-offer-tab-addon-annotated.png`: a tight highlight box now frames the "Refresh Data" button with no overflow or overlap with the neighboring step-3 badge.

3. **Missing destructive-action warnings (nit)** — **fixed correctly.** Step 2 now has a second `Important` note covering both points from the reference doc's §6 (clearing+saving deletes the translation with no undo; saving replaces the whole translation set, so let the page finish loading or use Refresh Data first). Wording is accurate and doesn't duplicate the existing curly-braces note.

Everything else re-checked this round (PII blur across all three images, arrow/highlight geometry, zoom clarity, prose-vs-reference accuracy) is unchanged and still clean — no new regressions besides the one filed.

Review round 2: 1 thing(s) to fix — 1 on the images. Two of the three round-1 fixes landed clean: the Refresh Data button is now correctly highlighted in step 3, and the destructive-action warning was added to step 2's notes with accurate content. The step-numbering fix (finding 1) was only half-applied — it removed the duplicate title text as asked, but left a new visible defect: the step-2 and step-3 callouts now render as an oversized, mostly-blank white card with a tiny numeral floating in the corner, on both images.
Job finished — article written, but 1 finding(s) still open after 1 fix round(s):

what: The step-2 callout (textbox, mode:'step', customNumber:2, title:'', hideBody:true, compactBadge:true, w:90) now renders as a ~90x100px blank white rounded card with only a small green circled '2' sitting in its top-left corner — the rest of the card is empty white space. Same defect on step 3's '3' badge (img/03-offer-tab-addon-annotated.png). This reads as a broken/glitchy component, not a clean step marker, and doesn't match step 1's tight 'Step 1' pill the fix was supposed to align with.

why: Quy trình mục 6 checklist: 'các component đã sử dụng hình dạng hợp lý chưa?' — a large blank card with a tiny numeral in the corner is not a reasonable shape and looks like a rendering failure to a reader. Root cause per snap_kit's text-box entry: title was set to an empty string but `hideTitle` (a separate real prop, default false) was never set — the title row still renders (just empty), which is what's reserving all that blank vertical space; hideBody alone only collapses the body row, not the title row.

fix: On both callouts, add `hideTitle: true` alongside the existing `hideBody: true` (title prop can stay '' or be removed) so the title row fully collapses and only the compact numbered badge remains, then snap_render_job and snap_view both images to confirm the card shrinks to roughly badge-sized instead of the current ~90x100 blank box. If hideTitle:true still leaves noticeable blank padding around the badge, try an explicit smaller `h` (e.g. ~50-60) on top of that rather than shipping the current oversized card.
